description: Fork of exp684 (1.4262 @ 140M, dual-stream per-layer residual_lut design at E=144 d_v=24). Continue the dim-scaling sweep: E 144 -> 96, d_v 24 -> 16. All LUT shapes unchanged. H*d_v = 96 = E (still symmetric). Param breakdown: qkv_lut 18.87M (unchanged, n_out=2*d_qk=128). v_lut: 6*512*64*16 = 3.15M/L = 18.87M (was 28.31M, -1.57M/L). out_proj: 1*1024*64*96 = 6.29M/L = 37.75M (was 56.62M, -3.15M/L). residual_lut: 3.15M/L = 18.87M (unchanged, out=D=384). tok_emb_E: 32768*96 = 3.15M (was 4.72M). Total ~110M (vs exp684 140M, -30M). Tests how far the per-layer residual_lut variant of exp611-arch scales down. References: exp684 = 1.4262 @ 140M (now <150M SOTA), exp683 = 1.4300 @ 140M (same dims, single read_out), exp611 = 1.4047 @ 289M, exp666 = 1.4544 @ 92.8M (<100M SOTA).
